{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check shape
print(f"Shape: {sales.shape}")

# Check for -1 in customer_age
age_count = (sales['customer_age'] == -1).sum()
print(f"Number of -1 values in customer_age: {age_count}")

# Check revenue dtype
print(f"Revenue dtype: {sales['revenue'].dtype}")

# Check if revenue has commas
has_commas = sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).any()
print(f"Revenue contains commas: {has_commas}")"}
